intro: Riche Gestoire France publishes a strong pitch and, a few clicks later, a set of qualifications that quietly change it. This review reads both in full.
The desk combines AI signals with manual control. Newcomers can start on the practice account, fund US$300 when ready, and trade 10 assets through the partner broker.
This review is built from the platform own words - every claim, fee note and disclosure it publishes. Where the page disagrees with itself, we flag it. The score follows the evidence.
whatItClaims: 10 crypto assets through broker partners.
A free demo account with practice funds.
Around-the-clock support through the partner desk.
Signals generated without manual chart reading.
A US$300 minimum deposit to start.
whatWeChecked: The performance story: no verified track record behind the return claims.
The number reuse: one score figure doing more than one job.
The deposit terms: minimum amount, payment methods and where the money sits.
The demo claim: practice account confirmed in the signup flow.
The payout promise: within-a-day wording without processing detail.
The broker relationship: which partner desk executes orders.

Free registration and a demo account.

Broker relationship described vaguely.
Registration details not stated up front.
The demo claim buried in the signup flow.
redFlags: Support figures that contradict each other.
Template placeholders left unrendered.
Return claims without verification.

faqs.q: Where is Riche Gestoire France restricted?
faqs.a: The lists conflict - different sections of the site name different countries. Confirm your eligibility with support before depositing.
The platform fee is absent, but every trade carries a broker spread the page itself calls the real cost. The headline says free; the fine print says otherwise. Budget for the fine print.

faqs.q: Is Riche Gestoire France safe, legit or a scam?
faqs.a: We found no scam indicators in the product, which reads as a functioning AI trading service. The conditions are editorial: claims without verification, conflicting figures and restriction lists that disagree. We rate it safe to research with the conditions in this review.

faqs.q: What does the published score actually mean?
faqs.a: It does double duty - a platform score and an early community response - and neither is independently verified. Treat both as marketing until proven otherwise.

faqs.q: What happens after I sign up?
faqs.a: You confirm the account by email, fund US$300, set your risk preferences and choose automatic or manual mode. The demo account runs alongside while you learn.

bottomLine: As a product, Riche Gestoire France offers the expected setup and nothing that breaks. The issues sit in the published claims, and the claims are avoidable if you trade the minimum.
4.5 is our number, and it means the product works with conditions attached. The demo costs nothing; use it while the claims remain unproven.
